title: "About"

I am a Master's student in Data Science in Computational Linguistics at the University of British Columbia (UBC). My interests lie at the intersection of data science, artificial intelligence, and language technologies, with a particular focus on how computational methods can help people communicate, learn, and access information more effectively.

Before joining UBC, I studied engineering in Egypt and worked as a Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer, supporting enterprise networks and solving complex technical challenges. My professional experience sparked a growing interest in using data to understand patterns, generate insights, and support decision-making.

I am also a co-founder of StreetKey, a data-driven platform that explores neighborhood livability and safety using structured and unstructured data. This experience strengthened my passion for analytics, machine learning, and human-centered technology.

## Interests

Outside of academics, I am a mother of two, a lifelong learner, and an enthusiast of technology and creativity. I enjoy swimming, going to the gym, creating Arabic children's storytelling content, experimenting with voice-over projects, and spending time with my family.

I am always interested in exploring how data, language, and technology can come together to create meaningful and impactful solutions.
